title: Hr Recruiter
description:
**Company Description** 
 Giridhar Eye Institute (GEI), located in Kadavanthara, Kochi, is an NABH\-accredited eye hospital offering a broad range of comprehensive eye care services. Established in 1997, GEI has grown into a recognized center of excellence known for its strong commitment to values and ethical medical practice. The institute focuses on delivering personalized, high\-quality care at an affordable cost to patients from diverse backgrounds. Team members at GEI work in a professional, patient\-centric environment that emphasizes integrity, clinical excellence, and continuous improvement. Joining GEI means contributing to a mission\-driven organization dedicated to patient satisfaction and community eye health.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site HR Recruiter role based in Kochi. The HR Recruiter will manage end\-to\-end recruitment activities, including understanding staffing needs, drafting job descriptions, sourcing candidates, screening resumes, and scheduling and coordinating interviews. The role involves maintaining candidate pipelines, managing communication with applicants, and supporting hiring managers in selection and offer processes. The HR Recruiter will also assist with onboarding new employees, maintaining recruitment records, and ensuring compliance with organizational policies and relevant labor regulations. In addition, the role may support employer branding initiatives, campus drives, and HR projects aimed at improving talent acquisition and retention.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Strong skills in candidate sourcing, resume screening, and interview coordination.
* Ability to manage recruitment cycles, from job posting and shortlisting to offer and onboarding.
* Knowledge of HR best practices, basic labor laws, and ethical hiring standards.
* Proficiency with applicant tracking systems, HR databases, and MS Office tools.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively at all levels.
* Strong organizational, time management, and follow\-up skills, with attention to detail.
* Ability to build and maintain positive relationships with candidates, hiring managers, and external partners.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; HR certifications are an advantage.
* Prior experience in recruitment, preferably in healthcare or hospital settings, is highly desirable.
* Commitment to confidentiality, fairness, and non\-discriminatory hiring practices.

title: People Operations Admin @ Resonate CX
description:
**People Operations Admin** 





 Recruitment  •  People Operations  •  Administration  •  Global Team Support
 




**About Resonate** 





 Resonate is an Australian customer experience (CX) software company. For a decade, we’ve helped organisations listen to their customers and act on what they hear. Today, we work across global markets, supported by a team spanning Australia, India, the Philippines, the UK and the US.
 





 We’re at an exciting point in our journey — growing, investing in our product, and building the kind of company people are proud to be part of. This is a brand\-new role, created to help us do exactly that.
 




**The Role** 





 As our People Operations Admin, you’ll play an important role in keeping our People Operations running smoothly and helping create a great employee experience across Resonate.
 





 This is a hands\-on role covering recruitment, people administration, onboarding, employee experience, culture initiatives and day\-to\-day People \& Culture support. You’ll work closely with the People \& Culture team, managers and employees across our global locations.
 




**What You’ll Do** 




**Recruitment** 



* Support recruitment activities including job postings, candidate screening, interview coordination and candidate communication.



**People Operations \& Administration** 



* Maintain accurate employee records, HR systems and documentation.
* Support day\-to\-day People \& Culture administration, reporting and employee lifecycle processes.
* Coordinate onboarding from offer acceptance through the first 90 days, including introductions, systems access and resources.



**People \& Culture Initiatives** 



* Support employee engagement, recognition, surveys, culture initiatives and internal People \& Culture communications.
* Help coordinate company events, team activities and employee programs.



**Global Team Support** 



* Support employees across Australia, India, the Philippines, the UK and the US.
* Coordinate activities across locations and time zones and work with local providers and partners.
* Help create connection, consistency and a positive employee experience across our distributed teams.



  





**About You** 





 You’re organised, approachable and genuinely enjoy helping people. You don’t need to know everything about HR — what matters most is that you’re curious, proactive and eager to learn.
 



* 1–3 years’ experience in HR, People \& Culture, People Operations, administration, recruitment or a similar role.
* Strong organisational and administrative skills with excellent attention to detail.
* Clear and confident written and verbal communication skills.
* Proactive approach, good problem\-solving skills and willingness to take ownership.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities.
* Experience using HR systems and Microsoft Office/365\.
* Ability to work confidently with AI tools and an interest in smarter ways of working.
* Basic graphic design skills.
* Event planning or coordination experience is a nice\-to\-have.
* Experience working with distributed or global teams is an advantage.



**What We Offer** 



* Broad exposure to People \& Culture and the opportunity to build your HR career.
* Real ownership and the opportunity to make an impact from day one.
* Exposure to leaders and teams across a growing global business.
* Learning and development opportunities.
* A supportive and collaborative team environment.
* The opportunity to grow with Resonate as the business continues to evolve.
* Opportunities to travel and experience different parts of the world.



**Why Resonate?** 





 At Resonate, we believe great customer experiences start with great employee experiences. We’re a growing, global team that values collaboration, curiosity, ownership and having a bit of fun along the way.
 





 If you’re looking for a role where you can learn, contribute and make a real difference to the employee experience, we’d love to hear from you.
 




**How to Apply** 





 If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now and tell us a little about yourself and why you’d be a great addition to the Resonate team.
